title: Test suite exceeds the 3-test minimum with strong edge coverage
evidence: test_app.py: 15 test functions (one parametrized ×6 = 20 effective cases) covering health, CRUD, author filter, validation errors, non-JSON body, bad year, and not-found paths

title: Empty ?author= query returns an empty list rather than all books
evidence: app.py:105-110 — `author = request.args.get('author')`; `if author is not None` treats an empty-string filter (`/books?author=`) as an active filter for author='' and returns []
suggestion: Optional: treat empty/whitespace author as no filter. Spec does not require this; behavior is defensible.
